% Terms (\WebTerm, in test-term.cfg) in a heading: the heading's id and
% table of contents entry have only the term's text, also for a term made
% with a robust command (\defn).
\documentclass{article}
\newcommand{\term}[1]{\textbf{#1}}
\NewDocumentCommand\defn{m}{\textbf{#1}}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\section{The \term{group} law}
A \term{group} is a set with an operation.
\section{The \defn{ring} law}
A \defn{ring} has two.
\end{document}
